headlines.text: Dow sinks to 49,097.06 (-2.19%) and S&P 500 posts its sixth straight loss to 7,175.83, the worst weekly stretch since April 2025, as Anthropic's IPO pop fails to revive the AI trade
Nvidia tops Q3 estimates with $115.8B revenue (+103% YoY) and strong Q4 guidance, but shares slide anew as the board confirms it won't reinstate ousted CEO Jensen Huang
Trump, Xi and Putin conclude their historic APEC trilateral in Shenzhen with a joint declaration on nuclear-risk reduction, UN reform and boosting oil output — but no mention of Ukraine
Fed's Oct. 28 minutes show almost all officials favoring further rate hikes, with Waller alone pushing for a supersized 50bp move at the December meeting
Initial jobless claims rise to 203,000 for the week ending Nov. 14, above the ~197K-208K consensus range, as the four-week average ticks up to 197,750
Walmart tops Q3 estimates with $188.8B in revenue and $0.65 adjusted EPS, raising its full-year outlook on strength from affluent shoppers
